name: Class Ten'i de Ore dake Haburareta no de, Doukyuusei Harem Tsukuru Koto ni shita 1
original_name: クラス転移で俺だけハブられたので、同級生ハーレム作ることにした 1
source:
After his class is teleported to another world, the protagonist is banished by 
his classmates due to his special ability that allows him to turn girls into slaves.

What does he decide to do in response to their actions......?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE192863.html]DLsite English[/url]]

Based on the popular web novel of the same title. The story covers the first 21 chapters of the web novel.
